description_en: Retrieves the details of a deployment package
description_zh: 调用GetDeployment获取发布包的详情
name: GetDeployment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the Settings icon in the upper-right corner of the page to go to the Workspace Management page and view the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed when you switch workspaces at the top of the Data Studio page.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment package. A deployment package ID is generated when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 发布包的ID。执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html 和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html时，都会生成一个对应的发布包ID
parameters.name: deployment_id

Data.description_en: The details of the deployment package

items.description_en: The details of the deployed item

Status.description_en:
The status of the deployed item. Valid values:
UNPUBLISHED(0): Unpublished.
SUCCESS(1): Deployed.
ERROR(2): Deployment failed.
CLONED(3): Cloned.
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): Deployment failed.
CLONING(5): Cloning.
REJECT(6): Deployment rejected
Status.description_zh:
UNPUBLISHED(0): 未发布
SUCCESS(1): 发布成功
ERROR(2): 发布失败
CLONED(3): 克隆成功
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): 发布失败
CLONING(5): 克隆中
REJECT(6): 发布驳回

Deployment.description_en: The details of the deployment package

CheckingStatus.description_en:
The check status of the nodes involved in the current deployment package. If the destination environment of the deployment package is the development environment (ToEnvironment is 1), you can continue to deploy files to the production environment only when the status of the deployment package is 1 and CheckingStatus is empty. Valid values:
7: Check failed.
8: Checking
CheckingStatus.description_zh:
当前发布包涉及节点的检查状态，当发布包的目标环境是开发环境（toEnviroment=1）时，只有发布包的Status为1并且CheckingStatus为空时，才可以继续进行文件到生产环境的发布。
7：检查未通过
8：正在处于检查中的状态

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the deployment package was generated
CreateTime.description_zh: 发布包生成的毫秒时间戳

CreatorId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the user who created the deployment package
CreatorId.description_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The specific error message recorded when the execution of the deployment package fails. This field is populated when the status is 2
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 当发布包执行失败（status为2）后，该字段记录具体的错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the execution of the deployment package started
ExecuteTime.description_zh: 发布包开始执行的毫秒时间戳

FromEnvironment.description_en:
The environment where the deployment is executed. Valid values:
0: Local.
1: Development environment
FromEnvironment.description_zh: 执行本次发布所在的环境，包括0（本地）和1（开发环境）

HandlerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the user who executed the deployment package
HandlerId.description_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment package, which is displayed on the Task Deployment > Deployment Package List page
Name.description_zh: 发布包的名称，显示在任务发布>发布包列表页面

Status.description_en:
The current status of the deployment package. Valid values:
0: Ready.
1: Successful.
2: Failed
Status.description_zh: 发布包当前的状态，包括0（就绪）、1（成功）和2（失败）

ToEnvironment.description_en:
The destination environment for the deployed files. Valid values:
1: Development environment.
2: Production environment
ToEnvironment.description_zh: 发布文件信息的目标环境，包括1（开发环境）和2（生产环境）

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues if an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
